sources.title: Jean Gallier, Clifford Algebras, Clifford Groups, and a Generalization of the Quaternions: The Pin and Spin Groups (full lecture notes, arXiv:0805.0311v3)
sources.locator: §1.2, printed pp. 13–17: Definition 1.3 constructs the tensor-algebra quotient with its universal property; the following calculation polarizes the quadratic relation; Theorem 1.4 states the finite-dimensional square-free ordered basis and dimension. Gallier works over R in this section and proves the basis using orthogonal decomposition; the batch proof is independent and covers arbitrary characteristic-not-2 fields and degenerate B.
